display_name: LoRa W24 完整 8,192 点 DURA 恢复（Full）
description: Train one scratch native DURA on a complete continuous capture and run the unchanged W24 front end on restored IQ. Same frozen model center-only readout is an output ablation.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: Receiver input 8192 contiguous 1 MHz complex IQ points. Model output same 8192; original W24 front end produces 8x2x432 from its returned waveform.
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: One scratch 111698-parameter native DURA, seed 2026112991, no imported checkpoint in training. The two readouts share its final epoch.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only
Previously frozen source comparator only in independent evaluation. No fitting or freezing access.
Unchanged original-loss 24,000-step U-Net for frozen evaluation comparison only, no fitting access

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered source U and physical IDs for scratch fitting. All comparison checkpoints and frozen E104 opened only for post-freeze comparison.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No checkpoint used in fit. Historical DURA, U-Net and W24 checkpoint rows are independent frozen source comparisons.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed update 24000. Whole native .5 readout must pass registered Full source qualification. Center ablation receives identical restored normalised centers and original W24 edges. Eligible target fixed Full three shards.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 GPU 3, fallback 5 or 6, 12 GiB live free and ordinary-account jobs checked. Single fitting worker.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on a systemic technical/protocol failure, incompatible source or frozen comparator, collision, or prediction/scoring failure. Preserve all artifacts. Source scores gate only target eligibility via preregistered paired rules.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --native-packet-dura after the three formal Full shards freeze.

rows.method: Identical complete native checkpoint, restored W24 centers and original W24 edges
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: No independent fit; uses the complete native model frozen at 24000 steps.

rows.method: Restore entire native capture before original W24 preprocessing
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 24000 scratch updates, batch 16, held milestones 2000, 6000, 12000, 18000 and final 24000.

notes: Continuous native time convolutions and two native identity MAP updates. A diagonal solve combines learned priors and per-sample positive variances, followed by carrier-DC and RMS projection. Both steps anchor to the received waveform.

Receive dechirp/CFO tracking at 1 MHz, inter-chirp features, out-of-band noise estimate, and three continuous prior cores. No W24 aperture during fit or native recovery. Both evaluation readouts use the same frozen checkpoint.
Only primary native .5 used for promotion. Same restored centers and original normalized received edges form the center ablation. Finite full-strength readouts are pressure diagnostics after freeze.
